title: Replace brittle character creation prompts with guided session-zero flow
description: Native Windows v0.1.1 smoke showed character creation is too brittle for real use. The revision loop loses prior answers, validation cascades into nonsensical messages such as 'level-1 hit point maximum must be -4', point-buy errors are reported only after the whole draft is entered, and users must manually derive level-1 HP. Rework character creation into a guided session-zero flow that preserves draft state between revisions, validates fields incrementally, computes derived values such as HP from class hit die + Constitution modifier, accepts common SRD display names where records exist, and produces actionable validation messages. Do not block /defer. Add tests for invalid class, invalid ancestry, non-integer scores, point-buy out-of-range scores, missing name after revision, and HP validation only when prerequisites are valid.
